metrics.name: TSMC Quarterly Revenue YoY
metrics.description: Leading indicator on AI silicon demand; proxy for whether the capex cycle is real.

metrics.name: Top-4 Hyperscaler Combined Capex (annual guide)
metrics.source: MSFT+GOOG+META+AMZN combined guidance from quarterly earnings
metrics.description: The central number for the AI arms race. Rising = bull cycle intact; guidance cuts = regime shift.

metrics.name: NVIDIA Quarterly Revenue (Data Center segment, USD billion)
metrics.description: The cleanest single number on AI-silicon demand. Q1 FY27 reported $81.6B total revenue (most is data center); Q2 guide $91B with zero China DC revenue assumed.

metrics.name: Hyperscaler Share of US Corp IG Index
metrics.source: Bloomberg US Corporate IG Index (META, GOOG/Alphabet, AMZN, ORCL combined)
metrics.description: Concentration of hyperscaler debt in the broad investment-grade index. Rising = passive-bond-fund exposure to AI capex is structurally levered; an early-warning signal for credit-spread risk if AI revenue stumbles.

metrics.name: Huawei Ascend 910C Reported Yield
metrics.description: Yield = % of chips on a wafer that pass quality testing. The clearest single number for China's chip-process maturity gap vs. TSMC. Industry standard ~60%; TSMC >90%.

metrics.name: SOXX Semiconductor ETF
metrics.description: Aggregate semis sentiment; AI capex reflected in upstream equity.

metrics.name: NVIDIA Stock Price
metrics.description: Fastest-moving single signal for AI capex demand expectations — if the cycle cracks, NVDA prices it first.

series.note: -7% on the week; SPCX IPO capital rotation

metrics.name: Frontier US AI Lab Valuations (private/IPO mark)
metrics.source: Series rounds, S-1 filings, IPO pricing
metrics.description: Combined frontier US AI lab valuations as they cross into public markets. All three (OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX/xAI) filed within 10 days in late May / early June 2026.

metrics.name: Largest Training Run (estimated FLOPs)
metrics.description: Are we still on the scaling curve? Log10 of compute for the largest known training run. Rising = curve holding; plateau = plateau.

metrics.name: SMIC Advanced Node Capacity (7nm/5nm)
metrics.description: SMIC's wafer-starts-per-month for 7nm-and-below. The clearest single metric for China's chip manufacturing independence progress.

metrics.name: US Data Center Power Demand
metrics.source: IEA / Lawrence Berkeley National Lab annual report
metrics.description: Total electricity consumption by US data centers. The binding-constraint signal for AI buildout; rising sharply from 2024 AI surge.
